notes: Built from ep004.ts lines: only tags and CAPITALS added; words identical to `say`.
persona: You are an energetic, charismatic science YouTuber narrating a vertical short video. Sound like a real human influencer talking to a friend: conversational, expressive, with natural breaths and a smile in the voice. Change your speed, pitch, emphasis and rhythm with what is happening: an excited hook, tension that builds as the numbers climb (a little faster and higher each time), a punchy pause right before every big reveal, quiet awe at the climax, a playful twist, and a warm, friendly call to action. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions or the bracketed tags aloud.

lines.style: excited and fast, big smile, rising on the question
lines.tagged: What if you jumped into a tunnel, STRAIGHT THROUGH the Earth?

lines.style: bright and playful, a tour guide with a grin
lines.tagged: You step off in Jakarta. The other end is in COLOMBIA.

lines.style: a quick cheeky aside, dry and fast
lines.tagged: Ignore the air, the heat, and the fact that this is IMPOSSIBLE.
Fifty seconds in, you pass the DEEPEST hole humans ever dug.

lines.style: building, a little faster and higher
lines.tagged: Minute five. You've fallen FARTHER than the Space Station is high.

lines.style: dramatic, a heavy drop on the last word
lines.tagged: Minute thirteen. You drop into the CORE.
And now you're falling FASTER than the Space Station flies.

lines.style: awed, slowing down, savouring the number
lines.tagged: Minute nineteen. <short pause> The EXACT center of the Earth. Nine point nine kilometers a second.

lines.style: calm wonder, the speed draining out of the voice as you slow
lines.tagged: And now the whole planet is behind you, pulling you BACK. You slow down, all the way up.
Minute thirty eight. You float out in Colombia, at exactly ZERO speed.
Grab the edge. Or you fall all the way BACK.

lines.style: playful and conspiratorial, like sharing a secret
lines.tagged: Here's the twist. Dig a SHORT tunnel instead, Jakarta to Bali, no engine, just gravity.

lines.style: amazed, a punchy pause after the first sentence
lines.tagged: It takes LONGER. <short pause> Forty two minutes. Through the whole planet: thirty eight.

lines.style: warm and friendly, straight to the viewer, smiling
lines.tagged: What should we dig next? The best comment becomes the next video.
